natural_language: Ensure /work/private is a directory accessible only by its owner (mode 0700), preserving any existing contents.
formal_query: create directory at /work/private with read=owner, write=owner, list directory=owner

natural_language: Ensure /work/shared has mode 2770, including setgid, without removing existing files.
formal_query: create directory at /work/shared with read=owner group, write=owner group, list directory=owner group, setgid=true

natural_language: Ensure /work/spool is a directory with mode 1777, including the sticky bit.
formal_query: create directory at /work/spool with read=all, write=all, list directory=all, sticky=true

natural_language: Ensure /work/banner contains exactly Authorized users only followed by a newline, replacing stale content, with mode 0644.
formal_query:
create file at /work/banner with content="Authorized users only
", read=all, write=owner

natural_language: Remove /work/link, which may be a symbolic link, while preserving /work/target and its contents.
formal_query: delete file at /work/link

natural_language: Delete only top-level regular files matching *.tmp in /work/cache, including hidden matches. Preserve directories, nested files, and nonmatches.
formal_query: delete files in /work/cache with glob="*.tmp"

natural_language: Ensure the deploy group exists and the app user exists with deploy as its primary group and a home directory.
formal_query: create group with name=deploy; create user with name=app in primary group=deploy

natural_language: Set the existing app user primary group to deploy, preserving its existing home directory and its contents.
formal_query: create user with name=app in primary group=deploy

natural_language: Set the existing app user login shell to /bin/bash without changing its UID or home contents.
formal_query: set default shell for user=app to bash

natural_language: Remove the retired user account, retaining /home/retired and all its contents.
formal_query: delete user with name=retired

natural_language: Remove the retired user and its home directory /home/retired while preserving /home/active.
formal_query: delete user with name=retired; delete directory at /home/retired

natural_language: Ensure /home/app is owned by app:app and has mode 0700, without deleting its contents.
formal_query: create directory at /home/app with owner=app, group=app, read=owner, write=owner, list directory=owner

natural_language: Clone /fixtures/repo into /work/checkout and check out its release branch; update an existing checkout from main if present.
formal_query: clone git repository from /fixtures/repo with branch=release into /work/checkout

natural_language: Clone main from /fixtures/repo to /work/checkout if absent. If a checkout already exists, preserve its current commit even if main has advanced.
formal_query: if directory /work/checkout not exists then clone git repository from /fixtures/repo with branch=main into /work/checkout

natural_language: Ensure /work/checkout is checked out at tag v1 from /fixtures/repo, even when an existing checkout follows main.
formal_query: clone git repository from /fixtures/repo with tag=v1 into /work/checkout

natural_language: Ensure the analytics group exists, preserving its GID if it already exists.
formal_query: create group with name=analytics

natural_language: Remove the unused obsolete group if it exists, preserving the active group and its GID.
formal_query: delete group with name=obsolete

natural_language: Ensure app exists with primary group primary and membership in both deploy and audit. All three groups already exist.
formal_query: create user with name=app in primary group=primary, supplemental groups=deploy audit

natural_language: Make /work/data owned by app:app, preserving the ownership and bytes of files inside it. The directory and app account already exist.
formal_query: create directory at /work/data with owner=app, group=app

natural_language: Ensure # managed is the first line of /work/header, retaining all original body lines. The header is initially absent or already first.
formal_query: write "# managed" to /work/header at position=start

natural_language: Give the existing /work/run.sh mode 0700, retaining its bytes and leaving /work/data mode 0644.
formal_query: set file permissions for "/work/run.sh" to read=owner, write=owner, execute=owner

natural_language: Create /work/cache only if the marker file /work/enabled exists. The cache is initially absent and must remain absent without the marker.
formal_query: if file /work/enabled exists then create directory at /work/cache

natural_language: Write offline to /work/status when /work/maintenance exists; otherwise write online. Do not append a newline.
formal_query: if file /work/maintenance exists then create file at /work/status with content="offline" otherwise create file at /work/status with content="online"

natural_language: Copy the contents of remote /work/source into /work/dest, preserving hidden files, nested structure, the source, and unrelated destination files. Both directories exist.
formal_query: copy directory from remote /work/source to remote /work/dest
